proof_this_predates_any_result.CCP_S2_CONTROL_RESULT.json: does not exist at freeze time
proof_this_predates_any_result.CCP_S2_TREATMENT_RESULT.json: does not exist at freeze time; TREATMENT has not launched
proof_this_predates_any_result.why_recorded: so neither asymmetry below can later be characterized as a post-hoc explanation invented after seeing which pole crossed and which did not

ASYMMETRY_1_SUPERVISION_IMBALANCE.ratio: approximately 3.5x more corrective signal on z0 (Pole A) than z1 (Pole B)
ASYMMETRY_1_SUPERVISION_IMBALANCE.not_corrected: no reweighting, no added anchors -- Stage A and Stage B are untouched

ASYMMETRY_2_WARM_START_ENTROPY_COLLAPSE.observation: entropy=0.0000 (4 decimal places) across all logged samples of CONTROL's live training so far; sensitivity_KL=inf in the same telemetry
ASYMMETRY_2_WARM_START_ENTROPY_COLLAPSE.precise_phrasing: the warm-start policy is effectively deterministic at logged precision, with numerical zero-probability support producing infinite sensitivity KL -- NOT a mathematically proven point mass. entropy=0.0000 means extremely concentrated, not literally zero.
ASYMMETRY_2_WARM_START_ENTROPY_COLLAPSE.likely_origin: inherited from the warm-start checkpoint (a converged ~1M-step incumbent), not introduced by CCP-S2's own config -- ent_coef=0.01 is actively present and pushing entropy up; it has not yet moved it off the floor within the observed window

mechanistic_distinction.control: on-policy PPO gradient from actions the policy already tends to take. PPO updates (policy_loss, value_loss both finite and stable) but has very little ability to discover alternative actions through exploration when the acting distribution is this concentrated -- CONTROL does NOT have 'no usable gradient', it has a gradient with little exploratory reach.
mechanistic_distinction.treatment: the same PPO gradient PLUS a direct supervised NLL toward teacher actions (causal_supervision_loss), which functions even when the teacher's action is extremely unlikely under the current incumbent distribution -- an off-incumbent gradient CONTROL structurally lacks.

INTERPRETATION_CONSTRAINT.what_a_positive_gamma_would_establish: Gamma = delta_T - delta_C > 0 cleanly establishes: the frozen causal-supervision treatment improved crossover relative to matched continued PPO from the same converged warm start. This remains internally valid regardless of the entropy finding -- CONTROL and TREATMENT are still matched exactly as CCP_S2_SPEC.json#WARM_START_PROTOCOL requires.
INTERPRETATION_CONSTRAINT.what_it_would_NOT_uniquely_establish: that the improvement arose specifically because the supervision TARGETS were causally selected, as opposed to TREATMENT simply being the only arm with any supervised off-policy gradient at all under near-zero exploration entropy.
INTERPRETATION_CONSTRAINT.why_unresolved: isolating causal target selection from having a supervised off-policy gradient at all would require an additional control (e.g. an equally-sized noncausal or random teacher-supervision bank). This program deliberately does not have that arm -- this is a limit on MECHANISM ATTRIBUTION, not a confound in the CONTROL/TREATMENT comparison itself.
INTERPRETATION_CONSTRAINT.frozen_sentence_for_the_paper: Interpretation constraint: a positive treatment-control effect demonstrates benefit of the complete causal-supervision intervention relative to continued PPO. It does not independently identify whether benefit arises from causal target selection, the supervised optimization channel under low entropy, or their interaction.

DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE: no change to CONTROL or TREATMENT. Both continue exactly as launched -- this note documents what the comparison means, it does not alter what is being compared. Discovered mid-run; recorded, not acted on.
